details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript payload (math_init.js) at install time. The payload is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, and makes use of eval, Function, and child_process. The package also depends on the known-malicious packages @or-sdk/base and @or-sdk/data-hub-svc. Installing this package executes the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
